changelog:
- Initial release of x402-endpoint-validator.
- Provides tools and instructions to test and validate x402 endpoints for proper 402 payment challenges, Bazaar extension support, and .well-known/x402 discovery manifests.
- Includes guidance for verifying payment schemas, service discovery, and common troubleshooting steps.
- Offers command-line examples and recommends the Agentic Market validator for comprehensive endpoint checks.
summary: Validate x402 endpoints — test 402 responses, check Bazaar extension, verify payment schemas, confirm .well-known/x402 discovery manifests. For agents and operators who want to verify their x402 implementation works correctly.
